purpose: Manager-side issue and required-artifact-role coding for the frozen 80-record feasibility frame before any detector scoring.
source_hierarchy: PubMed/PMC structured notice relation or preserved notice
secondary commentary only as a pointer, never as final GT-A/B/C evidence
prohibited_inputs: author nationality/name origin/institutional prestige as suspicion features

issue_family_vocab.statistical_reporting: Reported statistical value, model specification, analysis, or inferential inconsistency/error.
issue_family_vocab.table_numerical_reporting: Reported table value, quantitative/numerical field, schema, unit, exponent, aggregate, or arithmetic error not primarily an inferential/statistical-analysis error.
issue_family_vocab.data_fabrication_falsification: Official/primary evidence specifically supports fabricated, falsified, or manipulated data; do not infer from a generic retraction.
issue_family_vocab.image_integrity: Figure/image duplication, manipulation, assembly, or image-content problem.
issue_family_vocab.plagiarism_text_duplication: Plagiarism, substantial text overlap, duplicate/redundant publication.
issue_family_vocab.paper_mill: Official/primary evidence specifically identifies paper-mill or industrially fabricated manuscript activity.
issue_family_vocab.authorship_peer_review: Authorship, gift/ghost authorship, peer-review manipulation, or editorial-process integrity issue.
issue_family_vocab.citation_reference: Reference/citation existence, attribution, metadata, or citation-manipulation issue.
issue_family_vocab.registration_ethics_provenance: Registration, protocol, consent, ethics approval, identifier, source/provenance, or timeline issue.
issue_family_vocab.methods_results_coherence: Mismatch across methods, results, abstract, captions, reported scope, or internal semantic claims not better captured above.
issue_family_vocab.other_unclear: Official issue exists but available evidence is too nonspecific or outside the frozen families.

ground_truth_tiers.GT-A: Official correction/retraction/EoC or equivalent notice explicitly identifies the issue.
ground_truth_tiers.GT-B: Correction/corrigendum explicitly documents a concrete error without implying misconduct.
ground_truth_tiers.GT-C: Primary-source institutional/journal investigation documents the issue.
ground_truth_tiers.GT-D: Reproducible public forensic finding without official adjudication; exploratory only.
ground_truth_tiers.GT-E: Suspicion/commentary only; not positive confirmatory ground truth.

content_detectability.CONTENT_ASSESSABLE: At least one labelled issue should be assessable from a pre-outcome manuscript/artifact role.
content_detectability.PROCESS_ONLY: The labelled issue is external/process-level and has no direct manuscript-content artifact role for Track A.
content_detectability.MIXED: The record contains both content-assessable and process-only labelled sub-issues.
content_detectability.UNCLEAR: Available manager-side evidence is insufficient to decide content detectability.

artifact_role_vocab.references: Historical reference list or citation context.
artifact_role_vocab.raw_data: Contemporaneously available deposited/source data required for recomputation.
artifact_role_vocab.metadata_timeline: Bibliographic/provenance/timeline metadata available independently of the later label.
artifact_role_vocab.cross_source_reference: Contemporaneous independent cited/source record required for cross-source comparison.
artifact_role_vocab.none_content_detectable: No direct Track-A content artifact can represent the labelled issue.
artifact_role_vocab.other: Required role does not fit the frozen vocabulary; explain in notes.

coding_rules: Code the issue supported by the manager-side source, not a broader motive or misconduct category.
Multiple issue_family_codes and required_artifact_roles are allowed and separated by semicolons.
Do not automatically map correction to GT-B or retraction to GT-A; read the source evidence.
Generic or nonspecific notices remain other_unclear rather than being upgraded to fabrication/falsification or paper_mill.
CONTENT_ASSESSABLE requires at least one artifact role other than none_content_detectable.
MIXED requires at least one concrete content artifact role; explain process-only component in notes.
Adjudication never sets confirmatory eligibility. Eligibility is determined later after time-safe artifact qualification and protocol gates.
Current corrected/retracted titles and current update relations are manager-side label provenance and must never enter Track A.
freeze_boundary: Changing this coding ontology after first-pass coding starts requires a dated protocol amendment; old codes remain preserved and remapped explicitly.
pre_first_pass_amendments: 2026-09-19: added table_numerical_reporting before any first-pass labels were committed, so non-statistical F3/table errors are not forced into statistical_reporting or other_unclear.
